title: 收據頁面前端 (i18n + 自動產生 + 移除儀表板按鈕)
content: 前端部分：實作收據頁面（取代 demo receipt），從 DB 載入真實收據資料，支援三語（en/zh-hk/zh-cn），提供 PDF 重新下載按鈕，移除「回到學員儀表板」按鈕，並清理舊的 demo receipt 頁面。

findings: Receipt page at /[locale]/receipt/[enrolmentId] loads real DB data via /api/receipt/[enrolmentId]
PDF download generates on-the-fly via renderToBuffer (no S3 needed) with AES-256 password protection (first 6 digits of idDocNumber)
All 3 locales work: en, zh-hk, zh-cn — full i18n via dictionary system
Old demo confirmation page redirects to new route
No 'Back to Dashboard' link on receipt page
Page title + metadata set per locale via generateMetadata
Password hint shown below action buttons with example (e.g. A123456(7) → 123456)
Shared renderReceiptPdf() in render.tsx used by both download endpoint and generateReceipt
evidence.residual: None — all acceptance criteria met. PDF password protection uses first 6 digits of idDocNumber (done).

acceptance: Frontend receipt page at /[locale]/receipt/[enrolmentId] — Phase 1 route, outside (portal) route group
Page loads receipt data from GET /api/receipt/[enrolmentId] (receiptNumber, registrant name, course name, fee, payment date, LMC letterhead)
Receipt page UI in all 3 locales — English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese
PDF download button: generates PDF on-the-fly from DB (no S3), password-protected with first 6 digits of idDocNumber
Password hint displayed below action buttons with example (e.g. A123456(7) → 123456)
No 'Go to Learner Dashboard' button anywhere on the receipt page
Old demo confirmation page redirects to new route
Add receipt dictionary keys to en.json, zh-hk.json, zh-cn.json and types.ts
Page title and metadata set correctly per locale via generateMetadata
npm run typecheck + npm run lint pass
files: src/app/api/receipt/[enrolmentId]/route.ts (new — API to fetch receipt data from DB)
src/components/receipt/ReceiptView.tsx (new — receipt display with download/print/password hint)
src/app/api/download/receipt/route.ts (new — on-the-fly PDF generation + password protection)
verification: Visit /en/receipt/{enrolmentId} → shows real receipt data from DB, no dashboard link. PDF download button generates on-the-fly PDF (password: first 6 digits of idDocNumber). Same for zh-hk and zh-cn locales. Old demo page redirects. npm run typecheck + npm run lint pass.
